people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for access to the billboard and airport display network and its audience; staff time is secondary.

large_customers.reason: National and local brands and agencies buy campaigns, including national advertisers; the mix also includes local small businesses.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and maintains 60K+ billboard displays and airport advertising structures, with digital display upgrades and site lease obligations.

notes: Customer size is mixed, since local advertisers also buy billboards; recurring answer is a judgment call.
